title: Dinner Lady Bubblegum Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: That inimitable candy pop and sugary fruit rush makes this exquisite e-liquid a uniquely uplifting all-day vape for anyone with a sweet tooth and fond memories of the tuck shop. This e-liquid’s nic salt formulation and perfectly balanced 50VG/50PG ratio makes it ideal for use in classic and starter e-cigarette kits or refillable pod systems, and its high nicotine content and smooth throat hit particularly suits recent ex-smokers who’ve swapped cigarettes for vaping.
